customManagers.description: Keep every copy of the govulncheck pin on one version: the reusable workflows and the README. The test reads the pin from the workflow.

packageRules.description: Keep the go-ci integration Postgres on prod's major. Prod `personal-postgres` runs postgres:16-alpine (infra/reference/kvm4-platform.md), so a CI service on 18 would test against a server we do not run. Unpark when prod is upgraded.
